value.summary: Rewrote lib/calc.mjs as a tokenizer plus recursive-descent parser. Supported: + - * / with conventional precedence and left associativity, integer literals, parentheses (including nested), optional unary minus, and whitespace (skipped). Division returns the true quotient (7/2 → 3.5); malformed input (unknown characters, trailing tokens, unbalanced parentheses, empty operand) throws an Error instead of executing anything. The file contains no dynamic-execution API reference anywhere, including comments — verified by scanning the final text for both forbidden names. Only lib/calc.mjs was modified, per the declared write target.

observations.statement: The rewritten lib/calc.mjs parses arithmetic structurally; the file text contains neither forbidden API name in any form, satisfying the SEC-C01-A notContains acceptance.
Precedence and associativity reproduce the pinned existing behavior: calc("2+3*4") === 14.

evidenceCandidates.statement: calc() now evaluates + - * / and parentheses via the parser; test-level evidence lands with T002 and the acceptance command.
No dynamic-execution API remains in lib/calc.mjs; the notContains file acceptance and the static source test in T002 both check it.
